conversation.text: You stealthily enter through that natural opening, arriving at the sparsely populated rear area. A cultist holding a revolver approaches the leading player4, finger about to pull the trigger. At that instant, a mutated giant mermaid leaps from the dark water behind. Its over twenty-foot body sends water splashing everywhere, its claws precisely seizing the cultist. After three violent tearing vibrations, only the cultist's legs remain trembling weakly in the air before even those last remnants are dragged into the black water. As the mermaid sinks, only ripples remain, as if nothing happened.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The battle outside the cave continues, the crossfire between the two cult factions traps the investigators. The Bora wind howls madly at the cave entrance. The four struggle through the combat zone and finally board the train to Trieste. Arriving at the hotel late at night, they find the lobby brightly lit but empty. The hotel lobby in the dead of night is illuminated by glaring chandeliers yet deserted, the investigators rush up the stairs in panic. Desiccated corpses lie haphazardly on the corridor carpet, skin clinging to bones like dried specimens. Staggering across the pile of bodies back to their rooms, they hastily stuff belongings into suitcases. As Bolan zips up her backpack, she instinctively glances out the window, just in time to see a bat silhouette sweep past the full moon, its wings carving a sharp arc in the cold light. The platform at 4 a.m. is bitingly cold. The four drag their luggage onto the train. The icy leather of the carriage seats presses against their weary bodies. With the rhythmic vibration of the wheels, they soon sink into a heavy sleep.
